refactored collision behavior

collision detection is handled by the CollisionManager.cpp with its collection of Collision Components. CollissionComponent handles its bounding info for collision detection, its validity for collisions each frame, and sends relevant collision results to the dot to act on. The dot recieves the normal of the contact, the amount of overlap, and the other contacted body to decide how to react.
